decision: Scope ADR-0004 EvaluatorIdentityV1 Cargo.lock hashing (both cargo_lock_sha256 and compute_implementation_sha256's Cargo.lock input) from the raw 586-crate workspace lockfile to the canonical 59-crate scientific evaluator subgraph (feat-math plus jope-dime-regressor's evaluator runtime dependencies anyhow, hex, libc, rayon, serde, serde_json, sha2). Non-evaluator workspace crates (jope-carbon, jope-comparators, jope-service, ratatui, S3 stores) no longer churn EvaluatorIdentityV1 while any feat-math or evaluator runtime crate change still advances the digest. Append this ADR-0004 evaluator identity and lineage fixture provenance edge after carbon_v120_comparators_lockfile_identity_rebaseline. DSL ABI, known identities, and behavior fixtures stay unchanged. No shipped receipt proves this identity existed.
